decisions.reason: Bowl-surround lighting is a concrete decorative-lighting behavior owned by the source Requirement; the candidate's broader DJ-style visual identity remains valid unchanged.
The same-message Event already records the buttons, knobs, and silver DJ-booth finish, while measuring units were already required; the separate lighting addition does not change this candidate.
Adding bowl-surround lights does not replace or narrow the beige-and-green color scheme, and the silver control finish is independently represented under control styling.
The lighting decision does not alter machine branding or placards; exploring a K on the buttons is not a confirmed branding change.
Placing lights around the bowls does not change bowl capacity, depth, size, or form.
The source does not revise serviceability, internal-system access, or maintenance operations.
Decorative bowl lighting does not change valve operation, press-to-dispense behavior, flow control, or beverage consistency.
The decorative-lighting addition does not change the required mixing texture, foam quality, or high-speed mixing behavior.
Lights around the bowls do not alter spout placement, construction, orientation, geometry, or pouring behavior.
The source adds a product lighting feature but does not explicitly revise the system-layout or CAD deliverable requirement; downstream incorporation should not be inferred as a separate state change.
Although lighting may require electrical implementation, the source does not explicitly change the requirement to provide a finalized wiring plan, whose current state remains valid.
Bowl-surround lighting does not necessarily change bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or removal clearance.
